slides.filename: Part V - Full Setup Order Checklist.jpg
slides.heading: Full Setup Order Checklist
slides.description: Recommended sequential order for onboarding a new restaurant branch without missing dependencies
items: 1. Activate POS + Admin login (Company Code & Admin PIN)
2. Company Details + Branches (Legal name, address & VAT)
3. Tax + Units + Departments (15% VAT, kg/L units, kitchen depts)
4. Categories + Menu items + Addons (Dishes & customizers)
5. Extra charges + Payment types (Service, packing, cash/card)
6. Floor areas + Tables (Dining zones, capacity & layout)
7. Printers + Mapping + Test print (Receipt & KOT routing)
8. Users + Roles + PIN (Staff credentials & granular privileges)
9. Ingredients + Recipes (Raw materials & portion food-cost)
10. Storage locations + Vendors + PO + Receiving (Stock control)
11. Delivery APIs + Riders (Aggregators & delivery fleet)
12. SoftPOS card terminal (Payment bridge & reader pairing)
13. Gift cards / vouchers / loyalty (Promotions & customer points)
14. ZATCA details (KSA Phase 2 e-invoicing compliance)
15. Database backup / export (Baseline data snapshot)
16. Full test: order > kitchen > pay > one report
slides.note: Complete each milestone before accepting live paying customers.

slides.filename: Part W1 - Common Problems Floor Orders and Tax.jpg
slides.heading: Common Problems — Floor, Orders & Tax
slides.description: Instant frontline diagnosis and remediation protocols for floor orders and billing

items.title: Addon not showing on order
items.desc: Attach addon to dish in Masters > Addons, then sync till.

items.title: Discount buttons missing
items.desc: Admin: Settings > Discount; then reopen table ticket.

items.title: Extra charges missing on floor
items.desc: Admin: Settings > Extra Charges; ensure status is Active.

items.title: Tax looks wrong on bill
items.desc: Admin: Settings > Tax / Menu details; do not alter tax on floor.

items.title: Change Table / Merge not visible
items.desc: Role lacks permission; enable Change Table in Role Privilege.

items.title: Split / Settle not visible
items.desc: User role needs Settle permission (Cashier or Admin role).

items.title: Confirm split button is grey
items.desc: Remaining balance is not 0; assign remaining amount to tender.

items.title: Food voucher not applying
items.desc: Create voucher in Settings; verify valid code during Settle.

slides.note: Frontline staff should never change master tax or price records during service.

slides.filename: Part W2 - Common Problems Hardware Stock Delivery.jpg
slides.heading: Common Problems — Hardware, Stock & Delivery
slides.description: Remediation procedures for printers, inventory discrepancies, and online channels

items.title: KOT on wrong printer
items.desc: Fix department routing in Settings > Printer > Printer Mapping.

items.title: Stock not increasing after delivery
items.desc: Use Stock Receiving screen (creating a PO alone does not increment stock).

items.title: Transfer done but qty wrong
items.desc: Check from/to location selections and confirm complete transfer.

items.title: Report shows empty data
items.desc: Check selected date range filter and verify active branch.

items.title: Staff cannot open Stock
items.desc: Grant Stock / Inventory permission in Settings > Role Privilege.

items.title: Card payment always fails
items.desc: Check SoftPOS bridge service; disable training simulate for live.

items.title: Online order not coming
items.desc: Test Delivery API connection; verify aggregator credentials.

items.title: Food cost report looks wrong
items.desc: Audit recipe quantities and standardize raw ingredient units.

slides.note: If till shows 'Tile coming later', the feature is scheduled for a future release.

slides.heading: Daily Closing Checklist
slides.description: Essential 5-step end-of-day shutdown routine to ensure audit and cash integrity

items.title: 1. Settle open tables & tickets
items.desc: Ensure all dine-in tables, takeaway tickets, and unsettled payments are fully closed.

items.title: 2. Finish delivery & online orders
items.desc: Verify all courier handovers and online aggregator orders are completed or properly transferred.

items.title: 3. Review Payments & Sales reports
items.desc: Cross-check Payments Received report (Cash vs Card vs Online) against actual drawer cash.

items.title: 4. Execute Branch Day Close
items.desc: Perform Day Close for the branch as an authorized user and archive the generated closing report.

items.title: 5. Sign out & Secure terminal
items.desc: Sign out of Admin account; never leave counter terminals unlocked or unattended overnight.

slides.note: Day Close locks the accounting period and ensures tamper-proof financial reconciliation.

slides.heading: Customer Security & Compliance Rules
slides.description: Mandatory ISO/IEC 27001:2022 security policies for all restaurant staff and till operators

items.title: 1. Individual Staff Logins
items.desc: Each staff member must operate under their own unique username and PIN.

items.title: 2. Lock Counter Terminals
items.desc: Always lock or sign out of the POS screen whenever stepping away from the counter.

items.title: 3. Protect Admin Credentials
items.desc: Never share Admin passwords or PINs on WhatsApp groups, sticky notes, or public chat.

items.title: 4. Immediate Account Revocation
items.desc: Deactivate accounts of departing employees on the exact day of termination.

items.title: 5. Card Data Protection
items.desc: Strictly prohibit typing customer credit/debit card numbers in order notes or text fields.

items.title: 6. Incident Reporting
items.desc: Report suspicious logins, unauthorized voids, or cash variances to the Restaurant Owner immediately.

slides.note: Compliance with ISO/IEC 27001 protects restaurant financial assets and customer trust.

slides.heading: First Day Quick Start Summary
slides.description: Chronological operational milestones to achieve a successful opening day
items: 1. Open app URL > Activate POS with restaurant Company Code
2. Sign in as Admin using temporary authorized PIN
3. Company Details & Branches > Select active till branch
4. Configure Tax (15% VAT), Units, Departments, and Menus
5. Set up Floor Areas, Dining Tables, and KOT Printers
6. Create Staff Users with appropriate Role Privileges & PINs
7. Initialize Stock Basics (Storage locations, vendors, receiving)
8. Run test order: seat table, dispatch KOT, settle payment, review report
9. Start live customer operations with confidence
slides.note: Keep this quick start summary easily accessible at the manager workstation.
